q: Basic chemistry is the branch of science that studies the preparation, properties, structures and ____ of material substances.
e: Basic chemistry is the branch of science that studies the preparation, properties, structures and reactions of material substances. Reactions is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Basic chemistry is the branch of science that studies the preparation, properties, structures and reactions of material ____.
e: Basic chemistry is the branch of science that studies the preparation, properties, structures and reactions of material substances. A property is physical if measuring it leaves the substance itself unchanged, and chemical if composition changes.

q: Chemistry contributes to a large extent in the development and growth of a ____.
e: Chemistry contributes to a large extent in the development and growth of a nation. Nation is the idea that completes this fact.

q: A developing country, like Myanmar, needs talented and creative ____.
e: A developing country, like Myanmar, needs talented and creative chemists. Chemists is the idea that completes this fact.

q: To be a good chemist, one needs to understand the basic concepts of ____.
e: To be a good chemist, one needs to understand the basic concepts of chemistry. Chemistry is the idea that completes this fact.

q: On this context, there are six main themes in Basic Education High School Chemistry Course: Particulate nature of substances, Periodicity, Chemical calculations, Chemistry of reactions, the Environment and ____ chemistry.
e: On this context, there are six main themes in Basic Education High School Chemistry Course: Particulate nature of substances, Periodicity, Chemical calculations, Chemistry of reactions, the Environment and Organic chemistry. Organic chemistry studies carbon compounds, especially hydrocarbons and their derivatives.

q: Knowledge of these chemistry principles will help you to better understand the ____ and hazards to mankind and enable you to make intelligent decisions in the future.
e: Knowledge of these chemistry principles will help you to better understand the benefits and hazards to mankind and enable you to make intelligent decisions in the future. Benefits is the idea that completes this fact.

q: Knowledge of these chemistry principles will help you to better understand the benefits and hazards to mankind and enable you to make intelligent decisions in the ____.
e: Knowledge of these chemistry principles will help you to better understand the benefits and hazards to mankind and enable you to make intelligent decisions in the future. Future is the idea that completes this fact.
